collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The village gossips that a couple has been seen near the love hut: laugh it off, or ask for privacy.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend), who have been courting for a season, were seen walking toward the love hut last night, and by breakfast the whole village knows. The children are giggling. The elders are winking. (subject) is mortified. (friend) finds it rather funny. What should they do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) stands up at breakfast, takes (subject)'s hand and says, "Yes, and?" The village bursts out laughing. The teasing goes on for a week, then stops, because there is a new piece of gossip about a goat.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) asks the village, firmly, to mind its own business. The elders look ashamed and stop winking. The children keep giggling, because they are children. (friend) tells (subject) (friend.he/she) was very impressive.
